messages:
maria: Quick design check — putting the spend legend inline above the chart vs pinned to the right: thoughts? I prototyped both.
jon: Inline saves vertical space but might visually compete with chart title. Right-pinned is clearer but eats horizontal real estate.
aisha: Agree with jon. On wide screens right-pinned reads better. On mobile inline feels more consistent.
liam: Do we have analytics on how many users use the legend interactions (hover to toggle series)? If low, maybe collapse by default.
maria: Good Q — usage is low for toggles (<5%). Most just glance at legend then ignore.
jon: Proposal: default collapsed on narrow widths, expanded on wide. Add a clear affordance: "Show legend" that persists per user preference.
aisha: Accessibility nit: if legend toggles series visibility, make sure checkboxes have aria-checked and an aria-label that includes scope (org vs project). Example: `aria-label=\"Toggle Org spend series for 2025-02\"`
liam: +1 for persistent preference. Also suggest we add keyboard-only focus styles for legend items (outline + visible state change).
maria: Copy tweak: instead of "Show legend" use "Show chart legend (visibility settings)"? That might be verbose. Open to alternatives.
jon: Maybe "Legend & visibility" — shorter and implies settings.
aisha: For invoices panel — download CTA currently reads "Export". That confused support. Suggest "Download invoice (PDF)" and add aria-describedby pointing to invoice month.
maria: Good catch — users expected CSV sometimes. Let's be explicit.
liam: Mobile layout concern: org vs project toggle is currently a horizontal chip group above the chart, it wraps awkwardly. Consider moving it into an overflow menu on small screens.
jon: Overflow menu + a subtle top breadcrumb showing current scope would keep context.
aisha: Also check color contrast for the legend swatches — a couple are below 4.5:1 at small sizes. We should nudge palette.
maria: I'll update the prototype with: right-pinned legend on desktop (user preference remembers), inline collapsed by default on mobile in overflow, legend label "Legend & visibility", invoice CTA copy changed to "Download invoice (PDF)", and improved contrast swatches.
sam-bot: UX prototype updated at https://figma.com/file/abcd1234 — @maria pinned the latest frame.
jon: Quick follow-up: can we add a short tooltip on hover over the scope toggle explaining "Switch to project-level spend to see per-repo/project breakdown"? Some PMs asked for that.
aisha: Tooltip is fine but make sure it appears on keyboard focus too.
maria: Noted. I'll ship these to next design review. If no objections I'll push to dev backlog. :+1:
liam: No objections from me.
jon: Looks good. :eyes:
aisha: Thanks — will do a quick a11y test after dev flags are up.
